observed_history.limitation: Repository starts on 2026-11-14; changes establish activity, not a two-week stability trend. Cochanges are maintenance proxies, not proven caught bugs.

cost_note: Run wall times are shared costs, not summed per finding. Case seconds are before-call pytest durations. Null means not separately measurable. Observed runs count direct engine-CWD shell commands in Codex logs; hidden/wrapped commands are not complete coverage. See session-costs.json in the task report. Path churn spans the 9 available commits. Maintenance excludes initial creation and remains a cochange upper bound, not a caught-bug count. Installed-path string edits count in path history, not function-body edits.
